author: KEXP
description: Italian singer LA NIÑA crafts a sonic world steeped in Mediterranean vocal heritage, electronic landscapes, and club-driven pulse. With spell-binding vocals, she shares a performance of "GUAPPARÌA" and more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales.
title: LA NIÑA performs "GUAPPARÌA" & more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales
